axes.label: Aspect of the Turtle immunities and soaks

notes: Feign Death can cancel one Ritual of the Fang beam; Emergency Salve removes Envenom from the Hunter.
Master's Call or Posthaste handles Paralyzing Shots; Binding Shot and Intimidation control Ravenous Descendants.
Use a Mortal Wounds pet against Evolve healing and Venom Leech recovery; the source explicitly advises against spending Tranquilizing Shot on Ravenous Claws.
Feign Death cancels selected beams, Bloodthirsty Gaze, and Pulverizing Strikes; Emergency Salve removes Toxic Spew.
Master's Call or Posthaste removes Bloodthorn Roots, while Kodo Tranquilizer widens Spiny Shield removal.
Turtle blocks Thornblade but should not soak Lightbloom's Essence; Mortal Wounds reduces Pollen Surge healing.
Emergency Salve removes Toxic Spores; Turtle can clear several Rotten Mushrooms and intercept Echo of Nalorakk.
Posthaste removes Glacial Tomb and Frigid Roar from the Hunter; Tranquilizing Shot removes Mother's Wrath and Bestial Wrath.
Mortal Wounds reduces Healing Breeze or Feast of Misery healing but competes with pet-specialization benefits.
Feign Death cancels selected Fel Missiles and Drain Life targeting; Tranquilizing Shot removes Back to Work! and Fel Rage.
Binding Shot, Freezing Trap, and Intimidation control dangerous trash; Flare reveals Street Sneaks.
Mortal Wounds reduces Drain Life and Health Funnel healing; Turtle has boss-specific immunity uses.
Feign Death cancels selected Void Beam and Macestorm targeting; Emergency Salve removes Corrosive Essence and Atroxus poisons.
Posthaste removes Condensed Mass slowing; Tranquilizing Shot removes Bolster, Bloodsurge, and Feral Rage.
Control Protective Turtles; Turtle handles Sky Strike and Cosmic Crash, while Mortal Wounds reduces Feast and Mending Void healing.
Feign Death cancels selected Arrow Barrage and Addle Mind targeting; Emergency Salve removes Cytotoxin and Poison Spit.
Kodo Tranquilizer widens Accumulate Charge removal; control Temple Disruptors, Tormentors, and A Knot of Snakes.
Turtle blocks Caustic Stomp, soaks Corrupted Lifeforce, and can solo-soak Thunder and Lightning.
Feign Death cancels selected Bladestorm, Entomb, Drain Fluids, and Barrel Through targeting; Turtle is the alternate Barrel Through soak.
Emergency Salve removes Serpent Strike and Wretched Discharge; Kodo Tranquilizer widens Bound by Shadow and Captain's Bulwark removal.
Tranquilizing Shot removes Bestial Berserk and Ancestral Fury; control Assassins and Animated Gold, and use Mortal Wounds against Blood Drain or Healing Tide Totem.
Feign Death cancels selected Lightning Torrent targeting and can prevent Inferno damage when timed against completion.
Kodo Tranquilizer widens Stormcloud Barrier removal; Tranquilizing Shot removes Blaze of Glory.
Binding Shot limits Infused Whelp melee pressure.

recommendations: Intimidation with Guttural Roar can clear a clump, but Survival has limited additional answers.
Target-swap immediately; Takedown can be committed because the affix restores cooldown time.
Use melee positioning and baseline mobility to connect partner orbs.
Feign Death with Emergency Salve or Posthaste through Disengage clears the eligible effect from the Hunter; Exhilaration is a healing fallback.

provenance.description: Original structured summary of DoolB's Patch 12.1.0 Survival Hunter dungeon utility and affix recommendations. Talent strings and performance rankings are intentionally excluded.
